topotecan.review_status: Source reconciled; independent clinical, pharmacy and patient/PPI review pending
topotecan.source_basis: NCCP00311v4,00587v2 and current EMA Hycamtin product information; checked2026-11-02

risks.label: Severe myelosuppression
risks.detail: Neutropenia, thrombocytopenia and anaemia can be significant.

risks.label: Interstitial lung disease
risks.detail: Rare serious inflammatory lung toxicity can occur.

risks.label: Serious bowel inflammation
risks.detail: Severe diarrhoea, abdominal pain with fever, neutropenic enterocolitis or rarely perforation may require hospital care. Oral dosing needs early diarrhoea advice.

risks.label: Route-specific treatment and monitoring
risks.detail: Oral and IV topotecan have different doses and organ-function rules. Capsules require exact day/strength teaching, refrigerated storage and missed-dose advice.

risks.label: Hair loss, fatigue and mouth soreness
risks.detail: Effects can affect eating, energy and daily life; supportive care and dose changes may be needed.
